meta.name: geo-connector
meta.description: Search, query, and cross-reference NCBI GEO (Gene Expression Omnibus) datasets with ENCODE experiments. Use when the user wants to find GEO accessions for ENCODE experiments, search GEO for complementary datasets, download GEO metadata or series matrices, cross-reference ENCODE and GEO data, find supplementary files from GEO, or link GEO series to ENCODE experiments for provenance tracking. Also use when the user mentions GEO, GSE, GSM, GPL, GDS, series matrix, SOFT format, or needs to find expression data in GEO that complements their ENCODE analysis.
